new_entities.name: Gluten-free diet in non-celiac individuals
new_entities.description: Avoidance of dietary gluten in people without confirmed celiac disease.

new_entities.name: Self-reported gastrointestinal symptoms
new_entities.description: Patient-reported gastrointestinal symptom severity such as bloating, pain, stool changes, or general symptom relapse.

edges.effect_quant: Among 59 adults self-reporting non-celiac gluten sensitivity, fructan challenge worsened symptoms more than gluten, which argues that a gluten-free response is often a broader FODMAP response rather than a gluten-specific one. But two randomized gluten-challenge studies still found a meaningful subgroup that relapsed specifically on gluten.
edges.population: adults without confirmed celiac disease who self-report gluten sensitivity or functional gastrointestinal symptoms
edges.mechanism: Some apparent gluten responses may actually reflect fructans or broader fermentable-carbohydrate intolerance, while a smaller subgroup appears to have a reproducible symptom response to gluten itself.
edges.summary: This edge should stay mixed. Gluten-free eating can reduce self-reported GI symptoms in some non-celiac people, but the challenge literature shows that the benefit often reflects removal of fructans or other dietary triggers rather than a universal gluten-specific effect.
edges.caveats: This does not dismiss non-celiac symptom experience; it means the mechanism is heterogeneous. A self-imposed gluten-free diet can feel helpful while still being an imprecise proxy for the true trigger.

evidence.notes: Fructan, Rather Than Gluten, Induces Symptoms in Patients With Self-Reported Non-Celiac Gluten Sensitivity.

Evidence for the Presence of Non-Celiac Gluten Sensitivity in Patients with Functional Gastrointestinal Symptoms: Results from a Multicenter Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Gluten Challenge.
Double-Blind Randomized Clinical Trial: Gluten versus Placebo Rechallenge in Patients with Lymphocytic Enteritis and Suspected Celiac Disease.

effect_quant.comparator: clinical relapse on gluten versus placebo challenge
